review.headline: Stopped at 6 of 9 km; tempo block ran about 23 s/km slower than target with HR near max, so the session was not executed as planned.
observations: Planned 2 km warm-up, 5 km tempo at 4:37/km, 2 km cool-down; completed 6.0 km in 2020 s, avg 5:37/km, then called it.
Tempo laps 2-4 (3.0 km) averaged 5:00/km against the 4:37/km target, at avg HR 176 (max 179), so the effort was out of line with the intended pace.
Final km fell to 7:00/km at HR 158, showing a clear fade after the hard middle section.
Efficiency fell to 1.093 from 1.304 on the 11-03 tempo, and avg HR was 163 versus 148 for a similar session.
flags: Athlete reports heavy legs, poor sleep, and RPE 8, with an early stop at 6 km.
Cardiac strain at tempo pace suggests fatigue or overreaching, despite positive TSB of 12.7.
Only 1 of 7 planned sessions completed in week 2 (6.0 of 45 km), following 4 of 7 sessions in week 1.
CTL has dropped 5.7 over 7 days and no runs have been logged since 11-10.
